items.difficulty_reason: The counted unit is the author's own lemma lemma-descent-sheaf-fppf-etale at source lines 1416-1435: for f flat, locally of finite presentation and surjective, the functor from sheaves on Y_etale to triples (G, H, alpha) with G on X_etale, H on the fppf site of schemes over Y, and alpha : a_X^{-1}G -> f_{big,fppf}^{-1}H an isomorphism, sending F to (f_{small}^{-1}F, a_Y^{-1}F, can), is an equivalence. The author's proof at source lines 1437-1478 first obtains full faithfulness from the full faithfulness of a_X^{-1} and a_Y^{-1} (the latter from the author's comparison lemma, retained as context); then, for an etale covering of Y, proves a locality claim by observing that the covering covers the final object in each of the four sites so that sheaves are glueing data (a cross-chapter pointer), and remarks that a large commutative diagram of categories finishes the claim, with the details omitted; and finally reduces to X and Y schemes by a second claim using a surjective etale X' -> X and the first paragraph, where the scheme case follows from the corresponding Etale Cohomology result (a cross-chapter pointer) via the author's comparison of the sites of schemes and spaces (retained as context). The counted argument is thus a complete two-stage reduction; the author's own 'We omit the details' refers to the diagram chase of the first claim and is reproduced verbatim.
